title: Feynman on Scientific Method.
summary: A short clip of Richard Feynman explaining the scientific method: guess, compute consequences, compare to experiment, and why vague theories like astrology cannot be proven wrong.
why: Widely recommended as one of the clearest, funniest short explanations of what makes something science.

quote.text: it remains one of the best explanations of the scientific method around because it is clear, funny and short
